title: [DEV] Crash loop when xDrip battery status of G6 is available in NS
symptom: AAPS comes in a crash loop, seems to be caused by battery status from xDrip in Nightscout. The stacktrace shows a NumberFormatException for input string: "6 days (voltage: 308/289)".
cause: The bug is in xDrip's NightscoutBatteryDevice.java, caused by a commit that produces invalid battery strings like "6 days (voltage: 308/289)" which AAPS tries to parse as a number, leading to a NumberFormatException.
fix: A workaround was added in AAPS to ignore devicestatus entries with invalid data. The fix was implemented in a commit and confirmed to work.
evidence_quote: The bug is [here in xDrip](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/master/app/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/UtilityModels/NightscoutBatteryDevice.java#L126), caused by [this commit](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/92956f73f49dc199e2539ba055ec0d647876b91e).
